case_title: MIRZETA KUDUZOVIC FELICE VS. PHILIP ALANIZ

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,045.97 FILED BY FELICE, MIRZETA KUDUZOVIC AS TO DEFENDANT ALANIZ, PHILIP ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-04-2016 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (NO FEE) SERVED OCT-07-2016, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT ALANIZ, PHILIP

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-04-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-04-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. PLAINTIFF WAS PRESENT. DEFENDANT WAS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: J.BERTELSEN. NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-04-2016 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FELICE, MIRZETA KUDUZOVIC IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT ALANIZ, PHILIP THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED DOES NOT SUPPORT THE CONCLUSION THAT THE WORK PERFORMED ON PLAINIFF'S VEHICLE BY THE DEFENDANT IN APRIL 2015 CAUSED PLAINTIFF'S VEHICLE TO FAIL IN AUGUST 2016. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
